title: The Fake Paywall
short_caption: I let an AI audit my platform. It found a fake paywall — the button shipped before the checkout existed. Fixing it in public.
full_text:
Episode 1 of fixing Bleepx Academy in public.

The audit caught it instantly: a $9/mo Verified page with no checkout behind it. Now it's a free preview, honestly labeled.

Full receipts in the repo.
